result.title: Deterministic Prediction as Global Velocity: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecast
result.summary: Accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for many time series forecasting applications, and recent studies have increasingly adopted generative models to capture predictive uncertainty. Existing approaches often combine deterministic forecasting with generative modeling to improve predictive performance. However, their joint training is typically unstable because the deterministic model is embedded within the generative process, resulting in deep computational graphs and changing the probability transport path. In this work, we propose DV-Flow, a unified flow-matching formulation that incorporates the deterministic predictor as a parallel velocity component rather than as the endpoint of the transport path. This design enables stable end-to-end optimization while subsuming several existing formulations as special cases, allowing direct comparisons among them. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that DV-Flow consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance over strong baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/tufts-ml/dv-flow-time-series.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DV-Flow：把确定性预测器作为并行速度分量融入 flow matching，而非置于传输路径终点，以稳定端到端联合训练、统一若干已有公式，并在六个真实时间序列数据集上提升概率预测表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将确定性预测与生成式传输路径解耦、以并行速度分量联合训练的思路，可能为 LVR 中「直接答案生成」与「latent 推理状态生成」如何协同训练提供可核查的方法线索，但迁移到多模态推理的可行性需人工核实。
